thread:
maria.g: pagerduty alert fired for billing-usage-pipeline lag — page id PD-88932. seeing sustained backlog on usage-collector -> aggregator. customers may see delayed invoiceable tokens. paging oncall.
ops-bot: Incident bot: page fired to #oncall-sre (PD-88932). Severity: P1. Trigger: metric:usage_pipeline_queue_size > 3000 for 5m.
sam.k: acked PD-88932 — taking initial triage. I'm SSHing to collector pod to check ingestion.
sam.k: logs look like repeated 503s from model-proxy when writing KV to s3. snippet:
```
2026-03-14T09:12:02Z ERROR upload failed: 503 Service Unavailable
2026-03-14T09:12:03Z WARN retrying upload (attempt 3)
```
alex.r: finance-ops — any active billing runs right now? we need to know risk of invoice blockers.
finance-ops: not running daily billing job yet, it runs at 02:00 UTC. but if backfill is needed it will block invoice generation for some customers.
maria.g: rough customer impact: high-volume customers with streaming ingestion will have undercounted tokens until pipeline catches up. some customers that rely on per-minute usage will see missing lines in usage exports.
sam.k: moving traffic to fallback aggregator cluster (agg-us-west-fallback). executing runbook step: `kubectl scale deployment agg --replicas=0 && kubectl scale deployment agg-fallback --replicas=3`
ops-bot: Runbook step initiated by sam.k: switch-to-fallback-aggregator. Keep an eye on dedup idempotency.
jordan.lead: escalating to L2 inference infra for proxy 503s — @oncall-inference please join. these 503s look like transient model-proxy throttling.
pagerduty-bot: PD-88932 acknowledged by sam.k at 2026-03-14T09:15:18Z. Escalation timer paused.
sam.k: after failover, aggregator queue length dropped from 4.1k -> 200 in ~5m. pushing a small manual consumer restart to drain stuck batches: `kubectl rollout restart statefulset/usage-consumer`.
alex.r: can we stop the billing export until we confirm counts? prefer to avoid issuing incorrect invoices.
finance-ops: please hold exports. I'll open a temporary hold for impacted accounts in billing system.
maria.g: started incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/PD-88932 (private) — root cause unknown, mitigation in-flight. tagging billing, sales, and cs teams.
sam.k: found duplicated ack timestamps causing aggregator dedupe to skip items when S3 upload fails intermittently — some tokens were dropped from the stream. working on patch to make dedupe tolerant of missing s3 markers.
ops-bot: Suggested mitigation: run backfill job to re-ingest raw events from kafka for window 2026-03-14T08:30 -> 09:20. Command:
```
./backfill --topic=usage-raw --from=2026-03-14T08:30 --to=2026-03-14T09:20 --dry-run=false
```
sam.k: launching backfill in dry-run first, will validate output counts vs. expected. ETA for validation ~20m.
finance-ops: opened internal ticket BILL-1472 to track invoice hold and outreach.
maria.g: notifying affected customers via #support with draft msg — please don't send until CS approves. draft: "We observed an ingestion lag affecting usage reporting between 08:30 and 09:20 UTC. Our team has mitigated the issue and is performing a backfill. You may see updated usage and invoices in the next 24 hours."
alex.r: have we toggled auto-billing? if using current counts we might underbill. finance please confirm toggle.
finance-ops: auto-billing paused for accounts with flags 'hold_on_incident:PD-88932'. Will coordinate reconciliation after backfill.
sam.k: dry-run backfill results: restored ~96% of missing events, remaining ~4% are from batches that failed to write to S3 and are not present in raw topic. creating follow-up job to attempt partial reconstruct from pipeline cache.
jordan.lead: inference infra looking at proxy 503 root cause — rate limiter misconfiguration after last deploy. rolling a hotfix to model-proxy to increase retry window and catch 503s earlier.
ops-bot: PagerDuty update: PD-88932 escalated to L2 at 2026-03-14T09:36:00Z. L2 assigned: jordan.lead. oncall-sre remains sam.k.
maria.g: preparing customer impact summary for execs: short bullets ready — will post in incident doc.
alex.r: once backfill completes and counts validated, finance to run reconciliation job and resume billing exports. keep me posted.
sam.k: backfill completed at 2026-03-14T09:47:03Z. validation shows parity within 0.5% for high-volume customers. initiating reconciliation run: `billing-reconcile --incident PD-88932`.
finance-ops: reconciliation finished. adjusted invoices for 12 customers, created credit memos where needed. full audit logs attached to BILL-1472.
maria.g: incident declared resolved at 2026-03-14T09:50:27Z — mitigation verified, backfill successful, proxy hotfix deployed. root cause: model-proxy rate limiter regression from 2026-03-14 deploy causing S3 upload 503s leading to dropped batches.
ops-bot: Incident bot: PD-88932 closed by maria.g at 2026-03-14T09:50:27Z. Severity downgraded. Please run retrospective (postmortem) within 72 hours.
alex.r: thanks team. postmortem owners: sam.k (technical), finance-ops (billing impact), jordan.lead (infra). schedule postmortem and include remediation items: stricter pre-deploy rate limit tests, improved S3-write retries, automatic invoice hold toggle on pipeline lag.
maria.g: handing off to postmortem thread and closing this incident channel. :white_check_mark:
